sources.quote: Wii用１２cmディスク（1層/2層ディスク）

sources.method: 12 cm × 10 = 120 mm, from Nintendo Japan's Wii console page 'Wii用１２cmディスク' (https://www.nintendo.co.jp/wii/console/index.html).

sources.quote: Wii用１２cmディスク（1層/2層ディスク）
Wii用１２cmディスク（1層/2層ディスク）

notes: Nintendo publishes only the nominal diameter class (12 cm) and the layer options. Thickness, centre-hole diameter and clamp zone are not published by Nintendo; no public standard covers the Wii disc (it is proprietary). The family should not borrow ECMA-267 (DVD) values for this object without a source. shell null: Nintendo says nothing either way.
